notes.title: Demo is now live!
notes.content: [h1]Hey Stranger Dare you to love me - Demo Announcement[/h1][p]The demo for "Hey Stranger! I Dare You to Love Me!" is now LIVE and free to play! This experience will allow players to venture through the beginning of the game, landing our wayward protagonist in the bizarre-but-sultry town of Porte Avant. There you'll receive some tender care from Nurse Roo, learn a tiny bit about what to expect in this new environment, and perhaps even get some "night service". The entire experience, when played at average reading speed, will take around 45 minutes. This is, of course, just a taste... the Early Access version is right around the corner, and we can't wait to finally get this show on the road! [/p][p]Also, a special shout-out goes to Ken Ashcorp, who created the intro theme (which you'll experience when the full game releases)! While you're downloading the demo, why not go over to his Youtube video and give it a listen?[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="_LIifA-SduE;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Hey Stranger! I Dare You to Love Me! Store Page Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42656929/41847f86dee3ec761e45e0e7b8fdbde4c764b455.png[/img]

Hey there fans of lascivious and lewd ladies!

The official Steam Store page for [b]Hey Stranger! I Dare You to Love Me![/b] is now live with all the bells and whistles you would expect and ready to be [b]wishlisted[/b].

We're working our hardest to bring the title to you as soon as possible while keeping the quality of production as high as possible. 

Be sure to check the game's News page frequently for more updates coming soon.
